verifiedControls: Vercel preview reads and writes through server-side DATABASE_URL; browser does not receive database credentials
all preview write endpoints reject VERCEL_ENV=production
request IDs are UUID-v4 validated before consequential mutation
obligation identifiers are format-validated before payment, fulfillment and remedy mutations
commitment, payment, fulfillment, exception and remedy effects are persisted with canonical event lineage
partial acceptance conserves quantity: 4 kg performed + 1 kg shortfall = 5 kg ready
shortfall is represented by a separate canonical FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTION event
refund is not auto-created by acceptance; REMEDY_AUTHORIZED is a separate command/event
refund completion is a separate command/event and uses sandbox provider evidence
completed remedy transitions the preview obligation to FULFILLED only after the separate remedy completes
refund amount is proportionate to the original committed price: 1/5 of GHS 120.00 = GHS 24.00
database uniqueness constraints prevent more than one remedy for the same source exception and duplicate request/command/event/provider-reference identifiers

adversarialAssessment.sourceControl: complete-refund.js returns the existing COMPLETED remedy before mutation
complete-refund.js requires an existing AUTHORIZED remedy
authorize-refund.js selects only SHORTFALL/REJECTION exceptions with affected_quantity > 0

adversarialAssessment.attack: production execution of preview payment/fulfillment/remedy endpoints

adversarialAssessment.expected: no reopening or duplicate terminal effects
adversarialAssessment.sourceControl: READY/AUTHORIZED preconditions plus terminal idempotent readback

knownIncidentDuringRehearsal.finding: The first partial-acceptance implementation attempted two sibling aggregate_version updates in one SQL statement; PostgreSQL advanced only once and the FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTION event did not materialize.
knownIncidentDuringRehearsal.remediation: accept-fulfillment.js now advances by two atomically when shortfall exists and assigns acceptance to final_version-1 and exception to final_version.
knownIncidentDuringRehearsal.historicalRepair: The missing FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTION event was additively inserted as version 5 and aggregate_version advanced from 4 to 5 before remedy execution.
knownIncidentDuringRehearsal.result: The final observed chain is contiguous versions 1 through 7.
